Finite computations are corroboration rather than proof.

value.rationale: Both the scaling variable and the onset problem are natural features of an infinite spin chain near the saturation transition. The new functional describes all simultaneous long-distance/dilute trajectories and proves that an influential empirical onset extrapolation misses a genuine large-separation entanglement region. This is a mathematically motivated boundary and an infinite family of physical states, not a one-off numerical discrepancy.
